name: promptforge
description: Local-first prompt asset management and deterministic prompt compilation.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @promptforge/core && npm run build -w @promptforge/api && npm run build -w @promptforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @promptforge/core && npm run typecheck -w @promptforge/core && npm run typecheck -w @promptforge/api && npm run typecheck -w @promptforge/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @promptforge/core && npm run test -w @promptforge/core && npm run test -w @promptforge/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
